after.PASSED and VALIDATED: proposed to the owner as a paper strategy of its own (rule 14), sized by the risk engine, followed forward on paper; never real money
after.otherwise: reported as it is; nothing changes

spec.control: the same window, same weekdays, one week before and one week after each event
spec.data: Dukascopy minute bid and ask candles (datafeed), the two minutes of each day kept, the file's sha256 in the manifest; events verified on federalreserve.gov first
spec.financing: US policy rate public that day + 2.5%/yr, day count 360, per night held

gates.costs_x2: mean net per event > 0 with every cost doubled
gates.t: t of the mean net return per event over 2016..2021 >= the threshold
gates.timing: the events beat the same window a week before and after: mean difference > 0, Welch t >= 2.0
gates.top_year: no calendar year supplies more than 50% of the total net

spec.holdout_rule: 2022-01..2026-09: mean net per event > 0 with one-sided t >= 1.645, mean net > 0 with every cost doubled, and the events' mean above the controls' mean
spec.question: is the US 500 CFD's return from 14:00 New York on the day before a scheduled FOMC statement to 13:55 on its day positive after real costs, and above the same window on ordinary weeks?
